Collision |ranged_damage = [[File:Damage Icon.png|20px|Damage]]10 (Single)

[[File:ExplosiveRange.png|20px|Explosion Range]]5 (Explosion Range) |speed = 2 |hidden = {{Attr|Hidden|Yes}} |lead = {{Attr|Lead|Yes}} (Collision & Splash only) |flying = No }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''Mark I''' is the first vehicle that spawns from the [[Mecha Base]]. It spawns when the [[Mecha Base]] is at Level 0 or Level 1. As with other [[units]], it starts from the end of the map path and moves towards the entrance of the map. The '''Mark I''' has a spawnrate of 45 seconds at Level 0, which is shortened to 30 second at Level 1. '''Mark I''' can attack enemies with its turret. When the associated [[Mecha Base]] is at Level 1, the '''Mark I''' can also shoot rockets that deal splash damage. ==Appearance== '''Mark I''' is a tall light blue mechanized walker. It has long mechanized legs and its operator sits at the top of the walker. The operator can shoot bullets from its turret and rockets from its launcher when the associated [[Mecha Base]] is at Level 1. The operator itself has tan skin, its torso and legs were black, and it wears white goggles. ==Strategy== *'''Mark I''' can easily wipe out hordes of enemies. **After the associated [[Mecha Base]] is upgraded to Level 1, this job becomes much easier as '''Mark I''' can now deal splash damage. *On two-pathed maps, only one '''Mark I''' will spawn per Level 0/1 [[Mecha Base]]. It will go down a random path. *'''Mark I''' can deal full collision damage to enemies with defense, like the [[Giant Boss]]. **However, '''Mark I's''' ranged damage is still affected by enemies with [[defense]]. *As with other [[units]], the firerate and range of '''Mark I''' cannot be boosted by the [[Commander]] or [[DJ Booth]], respectively. *'''Mark I''' will struggle against some enemies with abilities that damage units. **For example, if the legacy [[Fallen King (Legacy)|Fallen King]] uses its ''Stomp'' attack, and a '''Mark I''' is caught in the attack, it is instantly destroyed, as the ''Stomp'' deals 500 damage. *The '''Mark I''' can be effective against hidden enemies, as it has hidden detection. **The '''Mark I''' cannot collide with ghost enemies, like the [[Soul]]. *'''Mark I''' can collide with the [[Balloon]] and [[Lead Balloon]]. **However, '''Mark I''' is instantly destroyed upon collision, and only the balloons on the respective enemies are destroyed. The enemies are still free to walk on the ground. ==Trivia== *'''Mark I''' replaced the [[XR600]], which existed before [[Hardcore Testing BETA]]. *'''Mark I''' was made exclusive in [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul Update]] as it is only used to test units in [[Hardcore Testing BETA]]. *The goggles worn by the operator inside '''Mark I''' are a re-textured version of the {{RLinkC|833772989|Laser Spec Special Forces Goggles}} accessory from the Roblox catalog. ==Update History== {{scroll|text = *'''28 August 2020''' -
